purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules differ from what production main deploys. 2.10.0 (main 4353ab5a) deploys the same Rules as 2.9.0; gameplay/r98 adds R98-01 League Roulette (owner R98-ROULETTE: the 'drops' counter on draw 3 setup ledgers and ssjrValidDropLedger, judged inside ssjrValidUpdateLedger; no new grant line). Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

added: // R98-01 League Roulette: a draw 3 ledger may also carry 'drops' (the roulette balls dropped so far): 0 at create, 1 on
// commit-league (the coordinator's first ball), then 2, 3, 4 through ssjrValidDropLedger only, and commit-clubs needs 4.
// It is written at create and never added or dropped later; ledgers without it keep their shapes.
hunks.why: R98-01 League Roulette (Nik 2026-11-20 option A): the 'drops' ball counter on draw 3 setup ledgers: exact keys, create at 0, a step never touches draw or drops except commit-league (0 to 1), commit-clubs after 4, one ball at a time by the right manager (ssjrValidDropLedger, asked only after the step checks refuse; the update grant line is unchanged).

R98-01 League Roulette (Nik 2026-11-20 option A): the 'drops' ball counter on draw 3 setup ledgers: exact keys, create at 0, a step never touches draw or drops except commit-league (0 to 1), commit-clubs after 4, one ball at a time by the right manager (ssjrValidDropLedger, asked only after the step checks refuse; the update grant line is unchanged).

removed: // R95-01: 'draw' never appears, goes or changes after create (any draw present is 3; absent stays absent and 3
// stays 3). One form for every ledger: the R95-01 sweep measured it 3 expressions cheaper than testing 'in' twice.
added: // R95-01 + R98-01: 'draw' (always 3, checked at create) and 'drops' (the roulette balls) never appear, go or
// change on a step, except that commit-league moves 'drops' from 0 to 1 (the coordinator's first ball is the league
// draw): -1 * 2 + 1 keeps an absent counter absent, 0 * 2 + 1 makes it 1. commit-clubs needs all four balls.
// One diff for both keys: the R98-01 sweep measured it cheaper than reading each key on both sides.
hunks.why: R98-01 League Roulette (Nik 2026-11-20 option A): the 'drops' ball counter on draw 3 setup ledgers: exact keys, create at 0, a step never touches draw or drops except commit-league (0 to 1), commit-clubs after 4, one ball at a time by the right manager (ssjrValidDropLedger, asked only after the step checks refuse; the update grant line is unchanged).

added: // R98-01 League Roulette: one ball (2, 3 or 4) dropped while the league is drawn and the clubs are not. Nothing but
// 'drops' and the write stamp changes, the count moves by exactly one (so a ball never drops twice), and the ball is
// the actor's: the coordinator drops the odd balls, his rival the even ones. The same authority as every ledger write.
// ssjrValidUpdateLedger asks it only after the step checks refused, which a drop fails on their first check (the revision
